name: io.github.Jannis-E/x402-mcp-server
description: MCP server exposing 5 pay-per-call x402 tools on Base Mainnet, each self-paying via EIP-3009 through a local wallet -- no API keys, no signup: Markdown Extractor, SPA Render & Extract, Burn-Once Secret Vault, SVG Bar Chart Renderer, GeoTIFF → PNG/WebP Tile Transcoder.

environmentVariables.description: EVM private key (0x-prefixed) for a wallet funded with USDC on Base Mainnet. Used to sign EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization payments -- never sent anywhere except the local signing call.
environmentVariables.name: BASE_PRIVATE_KEY
